products.name: Aurora 6 Smartphone
products.short: 6.1-inch OLED display, dual camera and all-day battery.
products.description: The Aurora 6 pairs a bright 6.1-inch OLED display with a 48-megapixel main camera and a battery that comfortably lasts a full day. Choose 128, 256 or 512 GB of storage; 5G and a tough aluminium frame come as standard.

products.name: Aurora Tab 11 Tablet
products.short: 11-inch tablet for reading, streaming and note-taking.
products.description: A slim 11-inch tablet with a sharp 2K display, quad speakers and stylus support. Ideal for reading, streaming and handwritten notes, with up to twelve hours of video playback.

products.name: Slim Folio Case for Tab 11
products.short: Protective folio that doubles as a stand.
products.description: A lightweight folio in water-resistant vegan leather. The cover folds into a stand at two viewing angles and wakes the tablet when opened.

products.name: Pulse Wireless Over-Ear Headphones
products.short: Active noise cancelling with 40-hour battery life.
products.description: Pulse headphones block out the commute with adaptive noise cancelling and play for up to 40 hours on a charge. Soft memory-foam cushions keep them comfortable on long journeys.

products.name: Echo Mini Bluetooth Speaker
products.short: Pocket-sized speaker with surprisingly full sound.
products.description: A compact, splash-resistant speaker with a passive bass radiator for fuller sound than its size suggests. Twelve hours of playback and a built-in strap for hanging on a bag.

products.name: Studio USB Microphone
products.short: Plug-and-play condenser microphone for calls and podcasts.
products.description: A cardioid condenser microphone that connects over USB-C with no drivers. Includes a desk stand, pop filter and headphone output for latency-free monitoring.

products.name: Nimbus 14 Laptop
products.short: 14-inch ultralight laptop with 16 GB RAM and 512 GB SSD.
products.description: At just 1.2 kg, the Nimbus 14 is easy to carry all day. A 14-inch 2.8K display, 16 GB of memory and a fast 512 GB SSD handle everyday work, while the battery lasts up to 15 hours.

products.name: Precision Wireless Mouse
products.short: Quiet clicks and a sculpted, comfortable grip.
products.description: An ergonomic wireless mouse with silent buttons, a high-precision sensor and a rechargeable battery that lasts up to 70 days. Pairs with up to three devices.

products.name: Low-Profile Mechanical Keyboard
products.short: Tactile low-profile switches with white backlighting.
products.description: A full-size mechanical keyboard with low-profile tactile switches, an aluminium top plate and adjustable white backlighting. Connects by Bluetooth or USB-C.

products.name: 27-inch 4K Monitor
products.short: Colour-accurate 4K IPS display with USB-C.
products.description: A 27-inch 4K IPS monitor covering 99% of sRGB, with a single USB-C cable for video, data and 65 W charging. The stand adjusts for height, tilt and swivel.

products.name: Linen Button-Down Shirt
products.short: Relaxed-fit shirt in breathable European linen.
products.description: A relaxed shirt cut from washed European linen that softens with every wear. Mother-of-pearl buttons and a curved hem that works tucked or untucked.

products.name: Wrap Midi Dress
products.short: Flattering wrap dress in fluid recycled fabric.
products.description: A midi-length wrap dress in a soft, drapey fabric made from recycled fibres. Adjustable tie waist, flutter sleeves and a hidden snap at the neckline.

products.name: High-Rise Straight Jeans
products.short: Classic straight leg in rigid organic denim.
products.description: High-rise jeans with a straight leg, cut from rigid organic cotton denim that moulds to you over time. Finished with a clean hem.

products.name: Organic Cotton Crew T-Shirt
products.short: Heavyweight everyday tee in organic cotton.
products.description: A heavyweight crew-neck T-shirt in 100% organic cotton, pre-shrunk so it keeps its shape wash after wash.

products.name: Slim Chino Trousers
products.short: Slim chinos with a little stretch for comfort.
products.description: Slim-fit chinos in cotton twill with a touch of stretch. A versatile trouser that works for the office or the weekend.

products.name: Packable Rain Jacket
products.short: Waterproof, breathable shell that packs into its own pocket.
products.description: A fully seam-sealed waterproof shell with a breathable membrane and an adjustable hood. It packs down into its chest pocket for travel.

products.name: Merino Wool Socks, 3-Pack
products.short: Soft, breathable merino socks for every season.
products.description: Three pairs of mid-weight merino wool socks with a reinforced heel and toe. Naturally temperature-regulating and odour-resistant.

products.name: Polarised Sunglasses
products.short: Timeless frames with polarised UV400 lenses.
products.description: Classic acetate frames fitted with polarised lenses that cut glare and block 100% of UVA and UVB light. Supplied with a protective case.

products.name: Leather Card Wallet
products.short: Slim card holder in vegetable-tanned leather.
products.description: A slim wallet with four card slots and a central pocket for notes, made from vegetable-tanned leather that develops a rich patina.

products.name: The Lighthouse Keeper's Daughter
products.short: A sweeping family saga set on the Cornish coast.
products.description: Three generations of one family and the secret kept by a remote lighthouse. A moving, atmospheric novel about loyalty, loss and the sea.

products.name: Beyond the Ninth Orbit
products.short: A gripping science-fiction adventure at the edge of the solar system.
products.description: When a deep-space survey crew receives a signal from beyond Neptune, they must decide how far they will go to answer it. Fast-paced, inventive science fiction.

products.name: A Quiet Murder in Kew
products.short: A cosy crime mystery among the glasshouses.
products.description: A retired botanist turns detective after a body is found in the Palm House. Witty, warm and cleverly plotted.

products.name: The Weeknight Kitchen
products.short: One hundred healthy recipes ready in thirty minutes.
products.description: Simple, seasonal recipes designed for busy evenings, each ready in thirty minutes or less. Includes meal-planning guides and a well-stocked pantry list.

products.name: Small Habits, Big Changes
products.short: Practical science on building habits that last.
products.description: A practical, research-based guide to forming good habits and breaking bad ones, with exercises you can start the same day.

products.name: A Field Guide to British Birds
products.short: Illustrated identification guide to 300 species.
products.description: A compact, fully illustrated field guide covering 300 species, with distribution maps and notes on calls, habitat and behaviour.

products.name: Otto the Brave Little Otter
products.short: A gentle picture book about finding your courage.
products.description: Otto is afraid of deep water until his friends need his help. A warm, beautifully illustrated story for ages three to six.

products.name: My First Atlas
products.short: Colourful maps and facts for young explorers.
products.description: An illustrated atlas with clear maps, fascinating facts and lift-the-flap surprises, written for curious readers aged five to eight.

products.name: Pro Blend 1200 W Blender
products.short: Powerful blender for smoothies, soups and nut butters.
products.description: A 1200 W motor and stainless steel blades handle ice, frozen fruit and nuts with ease. Includes a 1.8-litre jug and two travel cups.

products.name: Ceramic Non-Stick Frying Pan, 28 cm
products.short: PFAS-free ceramic coating on an aluminium base.
products.description: A 28 cm frying pan with a PFAS-free ceramic non-stick coating and a heavy aluminium base for even heating. Suitable for all hobs, including induction.

products.name: Pour-Over Coffee Set
products.short: Glass carafe, ceramic dripper and gooseneck kettle.
products.description: Everything you need for café-quality filter coffee at home: a ceramic dripper, a 600 ml glass carafe and a precision gooseneck kettle.

products.name: Ceramic Table Lamp
products.short: Hand-glazed ceramic base with a linen shade.
products.description: A table lamp with a hand-glazed stoneware base and a natural linen shade that gives a soft, warm light. Each glaze is unique.

products.name: Linen Cushion Cover, 45 cm
products.short: Stonewashed linen cover with a hidden zip.
products.description: A 45 cm square cushion cover in stonewashed linen with a concealed zip. Pair several colours for a relaxed, layered look.

products.name: Stoneware Plant Pot
products.short: Matt stoneware planter with a drainage saucer.
products.description: A 15 cm planter in matt stoneware with a matching saucer, sized for herbs and small houseplants.

products.name: Cordless Stick Vacuum
products.short: Lightweight cordless vacuum with 45 minutes of runtime.
products.description: A lightweight stick vacuum that converts to a handheld for stairs and cars. Up to 45 minutes of runtime and a washable HEPA filter.

products.name: Microfibre Cleaning Cloths, 10-Pack
products.short: Lint-free cloths for glass, steel and screens.
products.description: Ten reusable microfibre cloths that lift dust and grease without chemicals. Machine washable hundreds of times.

products.name: Daily Hydrating Moisturiser, 50 ml
products.short: Lightweight moisturiser with hyaluronic acid.
products.description: A fast-absorbing daily moisturiser with hyaluronic acid and squalane for lasting hydration. Fragrance-free and suitable for sensitive skin.

products.name: Vitamin C Brightening Serum, 30 ml
products.short: 15% vitamin C serum for a brighter complexion.
products.description: A stable 15% vitamin C serum with ferulic acid and vitamin E that helps even skin tone and boost radiance. Use in the morning before sunscreen.

products.name: Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50
products.short: Broad-spectrum mineral protection with no white cast.
products.description: A lightweight mineral sunscreen with zinc oxide for broad-spectrum SPF 50 protection. Sheer on all skin tones and suitable for daily use.

products.name: Sulfate-Free Shampoo, 400 ml
products.short: Gentle daily shampoo for all hair types.
products.description: A gentle, sulfate-free shampoo with oat protein and aloe that cleans without stripping natural oils.

products.name: Ionic Hair Dryer
products.short: Fast, frizz-reducing drying with three heat settings.
products.description: A 2000 W ionic hair dryer with three heat and two speed settings, a cool shot button and a concentrator nozzle.

products.name: Sonic Electric Toothbrush
products.short: Sonic cleaning with a two-minute smart timer.
products.description: A rechargeable sonic toothbrush with three cleaning modes, a two-minute timer and a battery that lasts up to four weeks.

products.name: Bamboo Hairbrush
products.short: Sustainable paddle brush with bamboo bristles.
products.description: A paddle brush with a bamboo handle and smooth bamboo pins that detangle gently and massage the scalp.

products.name: Non-Slip Yoga Mat, 6 mm
products.short: Cushioned, grippy mat in natural rubber.
products.description: A 6 mm natural rubber mat with a grippy textured surface and alignment markings. Comes with a carry strap.

products.name: Adjustable Dumbbell Pair, 2–24 kg
products.short: Replace a full rack of weights with one compact pair.
products.description: A pair of adjustable dumbbells that switch from 2 to 24 kg in seconds with a turn of the dial. Compact storage trays included.

products.name: Resistance Band Set
products.short: Five bands, handles and a door anchor.
products.description: Five colour-coded resistance bands from 5 to 25 kg, with cushioned handles, ankle straps and a door anchor for a full-body workout.

products.name: Two-Person Trekking Tent
products.short: Lightweight, freestanding tent for backpacking.
products.description: A freestanding two-person tent weighing just 1.6 kg, with two doors, two porches and a fully taped flysheet.

products.name: Insulated Steel Water Bottle, 750 ml
products.short: Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12.
products.description: A double-walled stainless steel bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Leak-proof lid and dishwasher-safe.

products.name: Trail Running Shoes
products.short: Grippy, cushioned shoes for rough terrain.
products.description: Trail shoes with aggressive 5 mm lugs, a protective rock plate and responsive cushioning for long days on rough ground.

products.name: Table Tennis Bat Set
products.short: Two bats, three balls and a carry case.
products.description: Two all-round table tennis bats with balanced rubbers, three 40+ balls and a zipped carry case. A great set for home or club play.

products.name: Graphite Badminton Racket
products.short: Lightweight graphite frame for fast, accurate play.
products.description: An 85 g graphite racket with an even balance for control and power, pre-strung and supplied with a full-length cover.

products.name: Creative Building Bricks, 600 Pieces
products.short: Classic bricks in 30 colours with idea booklet.
products.description: Six hundred compatible building bricks in thirty colours, with wheels, windows and an idea booklet to spark creativity. Ages four and up.

products.name: Magnetic Tile Set, 60 Pieces
products.short: Translucent magnetic tiles for open-ended building.
products.description: Sixty translucent magnetic tiles in squares and triangles that click together to build towers, houses and 3D shapes. Ages three and up.

products.name: Family Strategy Board Game
products.short: Quick-to-learn strategy game for two to five players.
products.description: Build trade routes and outwit your opponents in this strategy game that plays in 45 minutes. Easy to learn and different every time. Ages eight and up.

products.name: 1000-Piece Landscape Jigsaw
products.short: Highland landscape puzzle on thick recycled board.
products.description: A 1000-piece jigsaw featuring a sweeping Highland landscape, printed on thick recycled board with a linen finish to reduce glare.

products.name: Classic Wooden Chess Set
products.short: Folding walnut board with weighted pieces.
products.description: A folding walnut-finish board that stores weighted Staunton pieces inside, each with a felted base.

products.name: Off-Road RC Truck
products.short: Four-wheel-drive RC truck with 30 km/h top speed.
products.description: A rugged four-wheel-drive remote-control truck with oil-filled shocks, a rechargeable battery and a top speed of 30 km/h.

products.name: Mini Camera Drone
products.short: Beginner-friendly drone with HD camera and altitude hold.
products.description: A palm-sized drone with a 1080p camera, altitude hold and one-key take-off and landing. Two batteries give around twenty minutes of flight.

products.name: Arden Oak Lounge Chair
products.short: Solid oak lounge chair with removable upholstered cushions.
products.description: A low, generous lounge chair in solid FSC-certified oak, with deep removable seat and back cushions. Choose a natural or smoked oak frame and oat linen or charcoal wool upholstery. Delivered flat-packed, or assembled in your room.
